title: How to set up hot corners on a Mac

pieces.say: Still clicking through menus every time you lock your Mac?
pieces.text: Still clicking through menus every time you lock your Mac?
pieces.label: YOU'RE DOING IT WRONG

pieces.say: Here's the fix. Set up a hot corner.
Open System Settings, then Desktop and Dock.
pieces.text: Open System Settings, then Desktop and Dock.

pieces.say: Scroll down and click Hot Corners.
pieces.text: Scroll down and click Hot Corners.

pieces.say: Pick Lock Screen for one corner.
pieces.text: Pick Lock Screen for one corner.

pieces.say: Flick the pointer into the corner when you stand up. Locked.
